question: Round 2 (merged, m20532) verified the D2Q9 whole step (collide+stream, 30 steps) pointwise against lbmpy and explicitly left 'D3Q19 whole step' as debt. This round closes that debt with the same discipline: every arm is compared pointwise (per node, per discrete direction) against an independently constructed reference step.

scope.grid_note: (6,9,13) is asymmetric in all three axes so an axis transposition cannot cancel
scope.initial_field: discrete-equilibrium + sinusoidal rho/u perturbation + 1e-3 non-equilibrium noise, built by lbmpy_pointwise_ref.make_test_field('D3Q19', ...) -- the SAME float64 array is handed to both sides
scope.reference_step: S_ref = definition_stream3d (numpy np.roll, refcore3d) o Collide_lbmpy (LbmCollisionRule.lambdify, continuous_equilibrium=False)

arms.A5_mrt_native: solver3d.collide_mrt3d with native rates (s_e=1.19, s_eps=1.4, s_q=1.2, s_pi=1.19)

C1_code_equivalence.metric: eps_inf = max|f_arm - f_ref| / max|f_ref| at t=30 (worst over seeds), for A1..A4 against the SRT reference
C1_code_equivalence.rationale: fp64 round-off accumulation over 30 steps; round 2 measured 3.3e-14 for the D2Q9 analogue, so 1e-10 leaves >3 orders of margin while still catching any algebraic difference

C2_mrt_native_vs_symbolic.metric: eps_inf of A5 against MomentBasedLbMethod built from the repo's own _M_D3Q19_DATA

C4_conservation.metric: per-step relative mass drift |sum f^{n+1} - sum f^n| / sum f^n and max momentum drift / total mass

C5_convention_classification.prediction: a reference built with continuous_equilibrium=True must NOT match the repo (repo uses the discrete moment-conserving equilibrium); the mismatch is a convention artefact, classified WITHHELD-from-equivalence, not a defect
C5_convention_classification.metric: eps_inf(A1 vs continuous-equilibrium reference) at t=1 and t=30, plus sum_i f_i^eq,cont / rho at rest
C5_convention_classification.threshold: report only -- this arm is not an acceptance gate; it must not be silently omitted

C6_physics_shear_wave.anchor: u_x = u0 sin(k z) on a periodic box, amplitude decays as u0 exp(-nu k_eff^2 t), k_eff = 2 sin(k/2)
C6_physics_shear_wave.metric: relative error of the least-squares decay rate vs nu k^2 (continuum) and vs nu k_eff^2 (lattice dispersion)

C7_physics_abc.anchor: Arnold-Beltrami-Childress flow, curl u = u => exact decay exp(-nu t)
C7_physics_abc.metric: relative error of the fitted decay rate vs nu
C7_physics_abc.note: if the coarsest grid exceeds 3% the resolution study must show the error vanishing, otherwise C7 is FAIL (honest)

permutation_control.operation: apply the reference collision with the direction permutation set to identity

C8_sensitivity_controls.purpose: prove the metric is sensitive; a green gate on an insensitive metric is worthless

C9_frozen_refdata.metric: re-running the frozen gate reproduces the frozen reference and the frozen repo outputs
C9_frozen_refdata.note: the frozen bundle also carries per-array sha256 so tampering is caught

stopping_rules: If a code-equivalence arm stays above 1e-8 after removing a genuine setup bug, STOP and write the defect up as a finding instead of widening the tolerance.
No threshold may be relaxed after seeing a result; additional arms may only be ADDED.
If the physics arm misses 3% on the coarsest grid, report the coarse error as-is and let the resolution study decide the verdict.

environment.expected: python 3.11, numpy fp64, torch fp64, lbmpy 2.0 (provenance hashes recorded in summary.json)
environment.no_lbmpy_fallback: the frozen bundle (C9) makes the regression gate independent of lbmpy
